versions.changelog:
**Expanded platform support and improved integration in v1.2.0**

- Added Threads and Bluesky as supported platforms in the skill description.
- Updated dependencies: replaced "bluesky-sdk" with "@atproto/api" for Bluesky compatibility.
- No changes to usage, commands, or core post-generation features.

**Changelog for v1.0.1**

- Updated SKILL.md to add QR code images for WeChat and Alipay support sections.
- No functional or feature changes; documentation update only.

Major update: Adds video short scripts, AI image prompts, analytics features, improved A/B testing, and hashtag optimization.

- Added support for TikTok and YouTube Shorts video script generation.
- Introduced AI image prompts (DALL-E 3, Canva) for post visuals.
- Enhanced analytics and post performance tracking, including best time to post suggestions.
- Improved A/B testing with 3–5 post variations per platform.
- Upgraded hashtag optimization and Instagram story suggestions.
- Expanded support and contact options included.
Added rss-to-social integration, improved hashtag suggestions, better platform formatting, A/B testing variations
